[IARC.4.1] libds's runtime surface, mapped to its modules.

| Runtime concern                   | libds module |
|---|---|
| Consumption loop                  | `engine` |
| Working memory                    | `wm` |
| Schema registry                   | `schema` |
| Rete network                      | `rete` |
| Agenda + conflict resolver        | `agenda` |
| Clock source                      | `clock` |
| Recorder (stream events)          | `recorder` |
| Dispatcher (action-verb routing)  | `dispatcher` |
| Telemetry (metric + log callbacks)| `telemetry` |
| Cross-process / cross-machine I/O | **integrator territory** — not a libds module |
